meta.title: Round 2, how much new output backs the payout (question 4): the backing curve, the mechanism's own point and the break-even share
meta.prereg: prereg/2026-11-s63-round2-freeze.md (research-update; registered on OSF, https://osf.io/msdzk/overview; Amendments 1-4); the release reruns: prereg/2026-11-s90-private-price-at-sale.md, Amendments 2-6
meta.rows: part S points on the backing curve (0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), the mechanism's reading replayed with its backed share, 12 curves
meta.resultsFolders: r2-<part>-<env>-<years>-50bc51d (parts m, s, f, b), r2-tables-50bc51d, r2-erosion-50bc51d
meta.intervals: 95% bootstrap intervals over seeds 1-500 (the seed interval: the model's randomness only, not the choice of reading)
meta.note: for the "grid" and mechanism rows the backed-share column is the share (the engine key bkA prints percent; divided by 100 here): the part of the payout matched by new output; for the break-even row, the estimate is the share and the interval its ends
